# Release It! for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/release-it/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/release-it
```

- 37 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/release-it:release-it-<name>`.
- 21 subagents, started with `@release-it-<name> <task>`.
